query: 查询所有员工的名字和入职日期
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT name, hire_date FROM employee

query: 列出所有部门名称及部门编号
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT id, name FROM department

query: 查询今年入职的员工有哪些
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT name, hire_date FROM employee WHERE hire_date >= '2026-01-01'

query: 查一下编号为 1001 的客户的基本信息
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT id, name, phone FROM customer WHERE id = 1001

query: 展示所有产品的名称和单价
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT name, price FROM product

query: 员工总数是多少
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee

query: 查一下最近 10 条订单记录
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT id, order_no, amount, created_at FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

query: 哪些员工的邮箱还没有填写
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT name, email FROM employee WHERE email IS NULL OR email = ''

query: 产品表里有哪些产品类别
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM product

query: 按入职时间倒序看员工名单
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT name, hire_date FROM employee ORDER BY hire_date DESC

query: 统计每个部门的平均薪资
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT dept_id, AVG(amount) FROM employee JOIN salary ON employee.id = salary.emp_id GROUP BY dept_id

query: 每个部门下有多少名员工
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT d.name, COUNT(*) FROM department d JOIN employee e ON e.dept_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name

query: 2025 年 12 月各产品的销售数量汇总
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT p.name, SUM(o.quantity) FROM orders o JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.created_at >= '2025-12-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.name

query: 销售额最高的前 5 个订单分别属于哪个客户
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT c.name, o.amount FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id ORDER BY o.amount DESC LIMIT 5

query: 每个客户累计消费金额，按金额从高到低排列
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.amount) FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC

query: 张伟名下的客户有哪些
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT c.name, e.name FROM customer c JOIN employee e ON c.owner_id = e.id WHERE e.name = '张伟'

query: 各月订单量和订单金额趋势
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at), COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM orders GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) ORDER BY 1

query: 上季度销售额前十的客户及其负责人姓名
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.amount), e.name FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN employee e ON c.owner_id = e.id WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-07-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC LIMIT 10

query: 销售部每个员工的成交订单总额和主要负责的客户数
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT e.name, SUM(o.amount), COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN employee e ON c.owner_id = e.id JOIN department d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE d.name = '销售部' GROUP BY e.name

query: 对比各产品类别在华东区的销售额贡献占比
expected_sql_skeleton: SELECT p.category, SUM(o.amount) FROM orders o JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id JOIN customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.region = '华东' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC
